flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4104 then book the free first visit class for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown and store the reference as 'ref'.

remark: click: Clicking dismiss cookie notice button
click: Clicking Book free first visit button
click: Clicking the Free first visit class card in the Book a class panel
wait: queued plan (3 steps): type "Name"; type "Email"; select "Arrival time"
click: Clicking the I accept the climbing waiver checkbox
click: Clicking Continue to proceed with your booking
wait: PRIMARY: wait for booking confirmation to appear
analyze: the reference is stored as {{ref}}
assert: a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown

summary:
Booked the free first-visit class for Sam Rivera (sam@example.com) for November 2, 2026 at 12:00 PM.
Accepted the waiver.
The booking was confirmed with reference code PL-7302.
one_liner: booked a free first-visit class on the booking site
